title: Expectation bounded by a uniform $L^q$ norm
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $q\geq1$, and let $f\colon\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$. The absolute value of the uniform average of $f$ on $\Omega$ is at most its uniform $L^q$ norm, defined as $\bigl(\mathbb{E}_{x\in\Omega}|f(x)|^q\bigr)^{1/q}$.
